connector.name: Telemost MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Telegram channel analytics and statistics for AI agents, pay-per-call in USDC via x402.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.telemost.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package telemost-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.telemost, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Base (EVM) wallet private key (0x...) that funds x402 payments. One of EVM/SVM required for paid tools.

env.name: SVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Solana wallet secret key (base58) that funds x402 payments. One of EVM/SVM required for paid tools.

env.name: TELEMOST_BASE_URL
env.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.telemost.io.

env.name: MAX_PAYMENT_USDC
env.description: Per-call price ceiling in USD (default 2.5, covers the full catalog). Calls above this are refused before signing.

env.name: SESSION_MAX_USDC
env.description: Cumulative spend ceiling per process lifetime in USD (default 10).
